supersedingDecision.decision: Cratis/AI#264 records that this repository becomes a CI-published mirror and is then archived, so already-published v0.1.0 to v0.3.0 install commands and the evidence records that cite its tags keep resolving. The repository and its tags are never deleted.
supersedingDecision.note: The repository block below still reports the observed live state. This record does not change it, and does not change what any validator or workflow does. Applying plannedState is Phase 5 of Cratis/AI#264 and follows the Phase 2 re-pointing work.

phase2Execution.note: The public marketplace lane no longer writes to this repository at all: it stages, verifies, pushes, tags, and releases inside Cratis/AI, and mints no GitHub App token. This repository remains the write target only for the S10-blocked governed release lane, the disabled approved-profile activation job, and the credential-gated fixture and candidate review lane, none of which can execute today.

appliedOutOfBandByRepositoryAdmin.note: Branch protection on distribution and tag protection on dist/* are applied by the repository admin through the GitHub API, not by a workflow and not by a pull request, exactly like the protectedEnvironments recorded below. Record the observed protection settings here once they are applied.
required: orphan distribution branch created in Cratis/AI
distribution protected with force-push disabled, deletion disabled, administrators included, and no human push path
dist/* tag protection so a release tag is immutable once created
one real run of the re-pointed Stage Public Marketplace Distribution workflow, and host install evidence re-recorded at the new ref

findings: The contract in distribution/generated-repository-authority-request.md states that human or deploy-key direct pushes are not an accepted update path, yet commits 5d5c366, 53c607f, and 8f31eb0 in Cratis/AI.Distribution were authored directly by a maintainer rather than by the release bot, because the Cratis/Workflows#72 App is still not installed.

credential.state is REMOVED_AFTER_ONE_TIME_INITIALIZATION and repository.writeCredentialState is ABSENT_PENDING_PR_RELEASE_BOT, so the second repository currently has no compliant automated write path at all.
Consolidation removes the cross-repository App, the AI_DISTRIBUTION_APP_ID and AI_DISTRIBUTION_APP_PRIVATE_KEY secrets, the duplicated control plane, and one of two branch-protection surfaces.
